title: HB 2190 (107th General Assembly): As introduced, exempts a person 65 years of age and older from the requirements of showing an identification with a photograph of the voter when signing an application for ballot to vote. - Amends TCA Section 2-7-112.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(a)(1) (Section 1)
(quote) Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 2-7-112(a)(1), is amended by inserting the language "sixty-five (65) years of age and older or" in the third sentence between the language "a person" and the language "voting in accordance with".
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Section 2: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 511428-Draft (2011-12-11): the only saved version; exempts voters 65+ from the photo-ID sentence by inserting them into the existing carve-out (slot a).
(other) note: The inserted words sit in the existing sentence of 2-7-112(a)(1) that excuses persons voting under 2-6-401(a),(b) or 2-6-601 from showing photo ID; the bill text does not quote that sentence in full. Roll call is a 4-4 tie.

votes.motion: Subcommittee recommends passage, 4 yes to 4 no (tie) [version voted: Draft (no amendments in saved actions)]
